key: METEOR: I thought we might get some interference during all this, but I wasn't expecting you.
en: METEOR: I thought we might get some interference during all this, but I wasn't expecting you.
ja: メテオ: この状況で邪魔が入るかもとは思ってたが、まさかお前が来るとはな。

key: METEOR: Hey, isn't this a good time to test just how much that PULSE can super-charge us?
en: METEOR: Hey, isn't this a good time to test just how much that PULSE can super-charge us?
ja: メテオ: なあ、そのPULSEがどれだけオレたちを強化できるか試すには、ちょうどいい機会じゃないか?

key: VICTORIA: Step aside.
en: VICTORIA: Step aside.
ja: ヴィクトリア: どきなさい。

key: We're doing this.
en: We're doing this.
ja: これはやります。

key: You're kidding. Even that's not enough?
en: You're kidding. Even that's not enough?
ja: エイブリル: 冗談でしょ。それでも足りないっていうの?

key: Eh... Maybe this is for the best.
en: Eh... Maybe this is for the best.
ja: スティーブン: ま……これでよかったのかもな。

key: METEOR: Geez, I guess my heart's not in it.
en: METEOR: Geez, I guess my heart's not in it.
ja: メテオ: はぁ、どうやら気合が入ってないみたいだな。

key: VICTORIA: That's a cheap excuse for your own failure.
en: VICTORIA: That's a cheap excuse for your own failure.
ja: ヴィクトリア: それ、自分の失敗に対する安っぽい言い訳ですね。

key: METEOR: I mean, maybe... but we're on guard to keep one of our own here.
en: METEOR: I mean, maybe... but we're on guard to keep one of our own here.
ja: メテオ: まあ、そうかもな……だが俺たちは、身内の一人をここに留めておく見張り役なんでね。

key: Personally, I don't consider it a huge loss if he gets out.
en: Personally, I don't consider it a huge loss if he gets out.
ja: 個人的には、そいつが逃げ出しても大した損失だとは思わんが。

key: VICTORIA: Who are you talking about?
en: VICTORIA: Who are you talking about?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 誰の話をしているんですか?

key: METEOR: See for yourself.
en: METEOR: See for yourself.
ja: メテオ: 自分の目で見てみろ。

key: VICTORIA: Fine.
en: VICTORIA: Fine.
ja: ヴィクトリア: いいでしょう。

key: VICTORIA: ...You.
en: VICTORIA: ...You.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……あなた。

key: VICTORIA: ...U-um...
en: VICTORIA: ...U-um...
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……あ、あの……

key: \PN?
en: \PN?
ja: \PN?

key: You might want to... come here...
en: You might want to... come here...
ja: ちょっと……こっちに来た方が……

key: METEOR: It's not pretty to look at.
en: METEOR: It's not pretty to look at.
ja: メテオ: 見た目のいいもんじゃないぞ。

key: Don't say I didn't warn you.
en: Don't say I didn't warn you.
ja: 忠告はしたからな。

key: METEOR: I won't pretend to know why this all happened, but it still feels wrong.
en: METEOR: I won't pretend to know why this all happened, but it still feels wrong.
ja: メテオ: なんでこうなったのか、俺にはわからんが……それでも、なんか間違ってる気がするんだよな。

key: VICTORIA: That's...
en: VICTORIA: That's...
ja: ヴィクトリア: これは……

key: VICTORIA: The leader's son, right?
en: VICTORIA: The leader's son, right?
ja: ヴィクトリア: リーダーの息子、ですよね?

key: How could they do this to--
en: How could they do this to--
ja: どうしてこんなことを――

key: Ah, how do we--
en: Ah, how do we--
ja: ああ、どうやって――

key: VICTORIA: Like that, I suppose...
en: VICTORIA: Like that, I suppose...
ja: ヴィクトリア: そう、こんな風に……でしょうか……

key: VICTORIA: ...
en: VICTORIA: ...
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……

key: He's alive, at least.
en: He's alive, at least.
ja: 少なくとも、生きてはいます。

key: But what must have happened to his eye?
en: But what must have happened to his eye?
ja: でも、その目は一体何があったんでしょう?

key: TAKA: Wh...
en: TAKA: Wh...
ja: タカ: な……

key: VICTORIA: Are you okay?
en: VICTORIA: Are you okay?
ja: ヴィクトリア: 大丈夫ですか?

key: TAKA: That's...
en: TAKA: That's...
ja: タカ: それは……

key: ...A complicated question.
en: ...A complicated question.
ja: ……難しい質問ですね。

key: TAKA: Oh, \PN...
en: TAKA: Oh, \PN...
ja: タカ: ああ、\PN……

key: Well, this is about what I told you, isn't it?
en: Well, this is about what I told you, isn't it?
ja: これは、僕が話したことの通りになった、ということですよね?

key: Back at the Water Treatment Center... about what would happen if I betrayed--
en: Back at the Water Treatment Center... about what would happen if I betrayed--
ja: 浄水センターで……もし僕が裏切ったら何が起きるか、って話――

key: Ah--
en: Ah--
ja: あっ――

key: Well... at least I'm--
en: Well... at least I'm--
ja: でも……少なくとも僕は――

key: Ugh--
en: Ugh--
ja: うぐっ――

key: TAKA: This is a special kind of awful.
en: TAKA: This is a special kind of awful.
ja: タカ: これはまた、格別にひどい状況ですね。

key: VICTORIA: Hey, easy now.
en: VICTORIA: Hey, easy now.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ちょっと、落ち着いて。

key: Don't force yourself, okay?
en: Don't force yourself, okay?
ja: 無理しないでくださいね?

key: TAKA: You were... from Apophyll.
en: TAKA: You were... from Apophyll.
ja: タカ: あなたは……アポフィルの、

key: I'm sorry, for--
en: I'm sorry, for--
ja: すみません、その……

key: VICTORIA: Stop.
en: VICTORIA: Stop.
ja: ヴィクトリア: やめてください。

key: I've heard enough about that for one day.
en: I've heard enough about that for one day.
ja: その話は今日はもう十分聞きました。

key: And if you were going to say you betrayed Team Meteor, I'm tired of that too.
en: And if you were going to say you betrayed Team Meteor, I'm tired of that too.
ja: それに、メテオ団を裏切ったなんて話をするつもりなら、それにももう疲れました。

key: TAKA: Ahah... Rather your enemies stay your enemies?
en: TAKA: Ahah... Rather your enemies stay your enemies?
ja: タカ: ああ……敵は敵のままでいてほしい、ということですか?

key: But \PN knows...
en: But \PN knows...
ja: でも、\PNは知ってますよね……

key: Sirius caught me and then--
en: Sirius caught me and then--
ja: シリウスに捕まって、それから――

key: They wouldn't kill me, scion and all, so...
en: They wouldn't kill me, scion and all, so...
ja: 跡取りの僕を殺すわけにはいかなかったみたいで……

key: Well, you see.
en: Well, you see.
ja: つまり、その……

key: I don't know what's wrong with him--
en: I don't know what's wrong with him--
ja: 彼がどうしてしまったのか、僕にはわからない――

key: Maybe Lin has influenced...
en: Maybe Lin has influenced...
ja: たぶん、リンの影響か何かで……

key: But they decided I was a risk to set free, so they were just going to keep me here.
en: But they decided I was a risk to set free, so they were just going to keep me here.
ja: でも僕を自由にするのは危険だと判断されて、ここに留め置かれることになったんです。

key: VICTORIA: I see.
en: VICTORIA: I see.
ja: ヴィクトリア: なるほど。

key: VICTORIA: Here, lean on me.
en: VICTORIA: Here, lean on me.
ja: ヴィクトリア: さあ、私につかまって。

key: I'll get you back to safety on our side of the fence.
en: I'll get you back to safety on our side of the fence.
ja: こちら側の安全な場所まで連れて行きます。

key: TAKA: You're really just gonna trust me like that, huh...?
en: TAKA: You're really just gonna trust me like that, huh...?
ja: タカ: 本当に、こんなに簡単に僕を信じてくれるんですね……?

key: VICTORIA: I think it's clear by the condition of your face that you're not Team Meteor's ally.
en: VICTORIA: I think it's clear by the condition of your face that you're not Team Meteor's ally.
ja: ヴィクトリア: その顔の状態を見れば、あなたがメテオ団の味方じゃないことくらいわかります。

key: And frankly, if you were going to go to that length just to deceive us then you'd deserve the success.
en: And frankly, if you were going to go to that length just to deceive us then you'd deserve the success.
ja: それに正直、私たちをだますためだけにそこまでするなら、それはそれで成功に値すると思いますし。

key: Strength is built on sacrifice.
en: Strength is built on sacrifice.
ja: 強さは犠牲の上に築かれるもの。

key: Or so I've heard.
en: Or so I've heard.
ja: そう聞いたことがあります。

key: Now are you coming, or what?
en: Now are you coming, or what?
ja: それで、来るんですか、来ないんですか?

key: TAKA: ...
en: TAKA: ...
ja: タカ: ……

key: No.
en: No.
ja: いいえ。

key: Not yet.
en: Not yet.
ja: まだです。

key: Sorry...
en: Sorry...
ja: すみません……

key: I'll be okay, probably-- but go ahead without me.
en: I'll be okay, probably-- but go ahead without me.
ja: たぶん、僕は大丈夫ですから――先に行ってください。

key: I just need a moment,
en: I just need a moment,
ja: 少し時間が必要なだけなんです、

key: And then there's something else I need to do.
en: And then there's something else I need to do.
ja: それに、まだやらなきゃいけないことがあって。

key: VICTORIA: ...Suit yourself.
en: VICTORIA: ...Suit yourself.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……好きにしてください。

key: TAKA: I wonder if I was born for this pain...
en: TAKA: I wonder if I was born for this pain...
ja: タカ: 僕はこの痛みのために生まれてきたんでしょうか……

key: ...But that's silly.
en: ...But that's silly.
ja: ……なんて、バカげてますね。

key: It's just bad luck, right?
en: It's just bad luck, right?
ja: ただの運の悪さですよね?

key: Just bad luck in a world of obsolescence...
en: Just bad luck in a world of obsolescence...
ja: 時代遅れになりゆく世界の中の、ただの運の悪さ……

key: VICTORIA: How do I get in there?
en: VICTORIA: How do I get in there?
ja: ヴィクトリア: どうやってあそこに入るんでしょう?

key: VICTORIA: It's him.
en: VICTORIA: It's him.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 彼です。

key: I just need--
en: I just need--
ja: 私はただ――

key: VICTORIA: ...Mm.
en: VICTORIA: ...Mm.
ja: ヴィクトリア: ……ん。

key: VICTORIA: Looks like someone's already had a number on him.
en: VICTORIA: Looks like someone's already had a number on him.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 誰かがもう、彼をこてんぱんにしたみたいですね。

key: I'm almost jealous.
en: I'm almost jealous.
ja: 少し羨ましいくらいです。

key: But why is he in here?
en: But why is he in here?
ja: でも、どうして彼がここに?

key: SOLARIS: Who...
en: SOLARIS: Who...
ja: ソラリス: 誰だ……

key: VICTORIA: Good. You're awake.
en: VICTORIA: Good. You're awake.
ja: ヴィクトリア: よかった。目が覚めたんですね。

key: I would flinch to finish off a sleeping opponent.
en: I would flinch to finish off a sleeping opponent.
ja: 眠っている相手にとどめを刺すのは、さすがに気が引けますから。

key: Because I do have a sense of honor,
en: Because I do have a sense of honor,
ja: 私にも、誇りというものがあるので、

key: Unlike you.
en: Unlike you.
ja: あなたとは違って。

key: SOLARIS: ...Hah.
en: SOLARIS: ...Hah.
ja: ソラリス: ……ハッ。

key: I see...
en: I see...
ja: そういうことか……

key: SOLARIS: So, you are further judgment for my crimes?
en: SOLARIS: So, you are further judgment for my crimes?
ja: ソラリス: つまり、貴様も私の罪への裁きの続きということか?

key: VICTORIA: No.
en: VICTORIA: No.
ja: ヴィクトリア: いいえ。

key: Not all of your crimes.
en: Not all of your crimes.
ja: あなたの罪すべて、というわけではありません。

key: Just one.
en: Just one.
ja: ただ一つだけ。

key: You remember me, don't you?
en: You remember me, don't you?
ja: 私のこと、覚えていますよね?

key: SOLARIS: I'm afraid I can't even see your face clearly, girl.
en: SOLARIS: I'm afraid I can't even see your face clearly, girl.
ja: ソラリス: あいにく、娘よ、貴様の顔さえまともに見えんのだ。

key: Not after my own subordinate decided he wanted my eye above my position.
en: Not after my own subordinate decided he wanted my eye above my position.
ja: 自分の部下が、私の地位よりもこの目を欲しがって以来な。

key: VICTORIA: Then I'll fill in the blank for you.
en: VICTORIA: Then I'll fill in the blank for you.
ja: ヴィクトリア: では、その空白を埋めてあげます。

key: My name is Victoria Marlow,
en: My name is Victoria Marlow,
ja: 私の名はヴィクトリア・マーロウ、

key: Apprentice to Kiki Mikael Argall,
en: Apprentice to Kiki Mikael Argall,
ja: キキ・ミカエル・アーガルの弟子、

key: The purest soul in this wretched world,
en: The purest soul in this wretched world,
ja: この汚らわしい世界で最も純粋な魂を持つ人――

key: Whom you extinguished atop Pyrous Mountain.
en: Whom you extinguished atop Pyrous Mountain.
ja: あなたがパイロス山の頂で消した人です。

key: That was your mistake.
en: That was your mistake.
ja: それが、あなたの過ちでした。

key: SOLARIS: Ah, yes...
en: SOLARIS: Ah, yes...
ja: ソラリス: ああ、そうか……

key: I remember you now.
en: I remember you now.
ja: 今、思い出したぞ。

key: Even yapping pups may yet grow into their teeth.
en: Even yapping pups may yet grow into their teeth.
ja: ほえるだけの子犬も、いずれは牙が生えるものだな。

key: VICTORIA: Then be bitten and die.
en: VICTORIA: Then be bitten and die.
ja: ヴィクトリア: なら、その牙にかみつかれて死になさい。

key: CAL: Victoria.
en: CAL: Victoria.
ja: キャル: ヴィクトリア。

key: VICTORIA: WHAT?!
en: VICTORIA: WHAT?!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 何ですか?!

key: CAL: Easy, now...
en: CAL: Easy, now...
ja: キャル: 落ち着いて……

key: VICTORIA: Don't you dare try to stop me!
en: VICTORIA: Don't you dare try to stop me!
ja: ヴィクトリア: 私を止めようなんて思わないでください!

key: I heard what you said before and I've set it aside--
en: I heard what you said before and I've set it aside--
ja: 前に言われたことは聞きました。それは脇に置いておいたはずです――

key: But no matter what, there's no denying the irreversible truth that this man killed Kiki.
en: But no matter what, there's no denying the irreversible truth that this man killed Kiki.
ja: でも、何があろうと、この男がキキを殺したという取り返しのつかない事実は変わりません。

key: So I'll do what I must!
en: So I'll do what I must!
ja: だから、私はやるべきことをやります!

key: CAL: I'm not here to stop you.
en: CAL: I'm not here to stop you.
ja: キャル: 君を止めに来たわけじゃないよ。

key: Just to ask you a question.
en: Just to ask you a question.
ja: ただ、一つ質問したいだけだ。

key: VICTORIA: What.
en: VICTORIA: What.
ja: ヴィクトリア: 何ですか。

key: CAL: Is this what Kiki would want?
en: CAL: Is this what Kiki would want?
ja: キャル: これが、キキの望むことなのか?

key: VICTORIA: Don't.
en: VICTORIA: Don't.
ja: ヴィクトリア: やめてください。

key: CAL: Answer me.
en: CAL: Answer me.
ja: キャル: 答えてくれ。

key: VICTORIA: I have no obligation to answer you.
en: VICTORIA: I have no obligation to answer you.
ja: ヴィクトリア: あなたに答える義務はありません。

key: CAL: Because you already know that it's not.
en: CAL: Because you already know that it's not.
ja: キャル: それは、違うってことをもう自分でわかってるからだろ。

key: VICTORIA: Don't you DARE pretend for even a second that you know what Kiki would want!
en: VICTORIA: Don't you DARE pretend for even a second that you know what Kiki would want!
ja: ヴィクトリア: キキが何を望むかなんて、一瞬でも知ったような顔をしないでください!

key: CAL: Then tell me that it is.
en: CAL: Then tell me that it is.
ja: キャル: なら、そうだって言ってみてくれ。

key: Look me in the eyes and tell me that this is what Kiki would want from you.
en: Look me in the eyes and tell me that this is what Kiki would want from you.
ja: 僕の目を見て、これがキキが君に望むことだと言ってくれ。

key: Tell me that this is what she taught.
en: Tell me that this is what she taught.
ja: これが彼女の教えてくれたことだと、言ってくれ。

key: That this is the future, not only of Apophyll, but of Reborn.
en: That this is the future, not only of Apophyll, but of Reborn.
ja: これがアポフィルだけじゃなく、リボーンの未来なんだと。

key: VICTORIA: I--
en: VICTORIA: I--
ja: ヴィクトリア: 私は――

key: I'm--
en: I'm--
ja: 私は――

key: CAL: That's answer enough.
en: CAL: That's answer enough.
ja: キャル: それで十分答えになってるよ。

key: Come on, let's step outside.
en: Come on, let's step outside.
ja: さあ、外に出よう。

key: You have no business here.
en: You have no business here.
ja: 君がここにいる理由はもうない。

key: SOLARIS: Hmm...
en: SOLARIS: Hmm...
ja: ソラリス: ふむ……

key: So, that was Cal.
en: So, that was Cal.
ja: あれが、キャルか。

key: Perhaps... he is nothing like his brother said after all.
en: Perhaps... he is nothing like his brother said after all.
ja: もしかすると……兄が言っていたのとは、まるで違う男なのかもしれんな。

key: SOLARIS: And how about you?
en: SOLARIS: And how about you?
ja: ソラリス: それで、貴様はどうなのだ?

key: Do you wish me dead as well?
en: Do you wish me dead as well?
ja: 貴様も私の死を望んでいるのか?

key: SOLARIS: Mm...
en: SOLARIS: Mm...
ja: ソラリス: ふむ……

key: Given other events, it is a wish that may soon be granted.
en: Given other events, it is a wish that may soon be granted.
ja: 他の出来事を考えれば、その願いはじきにかなうのかもしれんな。

key: SOLARIS: I see.
en: SOLARIS: I see.
ja: ソラリス: そうか。

key: Then we may both be very unfortunate soon.
en: Then we may both be very unfortunate soon.
ja: ならば、我々二人とも、まもなく大いに不運な目に遭うのかもしれんな。

key: They have decided that I am a "risk" if not captive.
en: They have decided that I am a "risk" if not captive.
ja: 捕らえておかねば私は「リスク」だと、連中は判断したようだ。

key: I've heard that one many times before, but it's been quite a while since it was from those who I called my allies.
en: I've heard that one many times before, but it's been quite a while since it was from those who I called my allies.
ja: その台詞は何度も聞いてきたが、かつて仲間と呼んだ者たちから言われるのは、久方ぶりのことだ。

key: This world is given to change in so many ways...
en: This world is given to change in so many ways...
ja: この世界は、実に様々な形で移ろっていくものだが……

key: But nonetheless, that refuses to be one of them.
en: But nonetheless, that refuses to be one of them.
ja: それでも、それだけは変わろうとせんらしい。

key: SOLARIS: My former subordinates have a plan to flee north when they are done playing with you.
en: SOLARIS: My former subordinates have a plan to flee north when they are done playing with you.
ja: ソラリス: かつての部下どもは、貴様らと遊び終えたら北へ逃げる算段のようだ。

key: I suspect that several of them are in as much danger as I am.
en: I suspect that several of them are in as much danger as I am.
ja: その何人かは、私と同じくらいの危険にさらされていると見ている。

key: Well, let us see if this old man is capable of making any kind of difference after all...
en: Well, let us see if this old man is capable of making any kind of difference after all...
ja: さて、この老いぼれに、何かしら意味のあることができるか、見てみるとしよう……

key: TAKA: But if I've come this far...
en: TAKA: But if I've come this far...
ja: タカ: でも、ここまで来たなら……

key: I guess I really don't have much left to lose, right?
en: I guess I really don't have much left to lose, right?
ja: もう失うものなんて、大して残ってないってことですよね?

key: NOEL: Oh, there you are.
en: NOEL: Oh, there you are.
ja: ノエル: あ、いた。

key: Eve said to make sure you got this.
en: Eve said to make sure you got this.
ja: イヴが、これを必ず渡してほしいって。

key: But I wasn't sure how to find you.
en: But I wasn't sure how to find you.
ja: でも、どうやって君を見つければいいかわからなくて。

key: Here.
en: Here.
ja: はい、これ。

key: \PN obtained PULSE Read-out 10!
en: \PN obtained PULSE Read-out 10!
ja: \PNはPULSE解析データ10を手に入れた!

key: PULSE Dex updated!
en: PULSE Dex updated!
ja: PULSE図鑑が更新された!

key: NOEL: I just have to keep letting others find uses for me.
en: NOEL: I just have to keep letting others find uses for me.
ja: ノエル: 僕はただ、みんなに使い道を見つけてもらい続けるしかないんだよね。

key: A switch on the machine opens the case.
en: A switch on the machine opens the case.
ja: 機械のスイッチを押すとケースが開くようだ。

key: Press it?
en: Press it?
ja: 押す?

key: Who wouldn't?
en: Who wouldn't?
ja: 押さない人なんている?

key: Better not...
en: Better not...
ja: やめておこう……

key: I'd be lying if I said I didn't feel out of place in this battle...
en: I'd be lying if I said I didn't feel out of place in this battle...
ja: このバトルに場違いさを感じてないと言ったら、うそになるな……

key: Then that's it, is it?
en: Then that's it, is it?
ja: デリル: では、これで終わりか?

key: Science for its own sake rarely pans out.
en: Science for its own sake rarely pans out.
ja: 科学のための科学というのは、なかなかうまくいかんものだ。

key: But one last hurrah for all the marbles!
en: But one last hurrah for all the marbles!
ja: だが、最後の大勝負といこう!

key: Time to find a new job, I suppose.
en: Time to find a new job, I suppose.
ja: ナオマン: そろそろ新しい仕事でも探す頃かな。

key: No, I suppose I'll be sweeping the floor of some cell, won't I?
en: No, I suppose I'll be sweeping the floor of some cell, won't I?
ja: いや、どこかの独房の床でも掃くことになるんだろうな。

key: EVE: ...Ah, you're going down there already?
en: EVE: ...Ah, you're going down there already?
ja: イヴ: ……ああ、もう下に行くのね?

key: Tch, I'm sorry...
en: Tch, I'm sorry...
ja: ちっ、ごめんなさい……

key: I haven't compiled all of the data yet.
en: I haven't compiled all of the data yet.
ja: まだ全部のデータをまとめきれてないの。

key: Something went wrong.
en: Something went wrong.
ja: 何かがおかしくなった。

key: Maybe the machine overloaded, or went haywire.
en: Maybe the machine overloaded, or went haywire.
ja: 機械が過負荷になったか、暴走したのかもしれない。

key: I don't know exactly what we're dealing with, but...
en: I don't know exactly what we're dealing with, but...
ja: 何を相手にしているのか正確にはわからないけど……

key: It seems to be weak to Fairy Type attacks,
en: It seems to be weak to Fairy Type attacks,
ja: フェアリータイプの攻撃に弱いみたいなの、

key: And it doesn't have much offensive presence, but damaging it by conventional means may not be possible...
en: And it doesn't have much offensive presence, but damaging it by conventional means may not be possible...
ja: 攻撃性はそんなにないみたいだけど、普通の手段じゃダメージが通らないかもしれない……

key: I wish I had more details for you already.
en: I wish I had more details for you already.
ja: もっと詳しい情報を渡せてればよかったんだけど。

key: Give me just a little more time...
en: Give me just a little more time...
ja: もう少しだけ時間をちょうだい……

key: It could be dangerous down there.
en: It could be dangerous down there.
ja: 下は危険かもしれないから。

key: Please be careful.
en: Please be careful.
ja: 気をつけてね。

key: I'll keep watching in case anything changes.
en: I'll keep watching in case anything changes.
ja: 何か変化があったら、ずっと見ておくから。

key: EVE: All I know for sure is that damaging it conventionally probably won't work, and Fairy Types are its greatest weakness...
en: EVE: All I know for sure is that damaging it conventionally probably won't work, and Fairy Types are its greatest weakness...
ja: イヴ: 確実にわかってるのは、普通の手段じゃたぶんダメージが通らないってことと、フェアリータイプが一番の弱点だってことだけ……

key: But all of these readings...
en: But all of these readings...
ja: でも、このデータの数値……

key: I haven't seen anything like this before.
en: I haven't seen anything like this before.
ja: こんなの、今まで見たことない。

key: Did the subject break its own machine?
en: Did the subject break its own machine?
ja: 対象は自分の機械を壊したのかしら?

key: But it's supposed to just be...
en: But it's supposed to just be...
ja: でも、これって本来はただの……
ユーフィ: ……ん。

key: EVE: Perfect timing; I just finished compiling this.
en: EVE: Perfect timing; I just finished compiling this.
ja: イヴ: ちょうどよかった、たった今まとめ終わったところ。

key: \PN obtained PULSE Read-out 09!
en: \PN obtained PULSE Read-out 09!
ja: \PNはPULSE解析データ09を手に入れた!

key: EVE: But these readings...
en: EVE: But these readings...
ja: イヴ: でも、このデータ……

key: They only just showed up, but it seems like the machine may have overloaded or gone haywire.
en: They only just showed up, but it seems like the machine may have overloaded or gone haywire.
ja: つい最近出てきたばかりなんだけど、機械が過負荷になったか暴走したみたいなの。

key: I don't know what's happening, but it could be dangerous down there.
en: I don't know what's happening, but it could be dangerous down there.
ja: 何が起きてるのかわからないけど、下は危険かもしれない。

key: EVE: I haven't seen anything like this before...
en: EVE: I haven't seen anything like this before...
ja: イヴ: こんなの、今まで見たことない……

key: EVE: \PN!
en: EVE: \PN!
ja: イヴ: \PN!

key: Sorry it took so long; I finally compiled the data for that thing.
en: Sorry it took so long; I finally compiled the data for that thing.
ja: 遅くなってごめんね、あれのデータ、やっとまとめ終わったから。

key: EVE: ...This was a culmination of my failures and weaknesses,
en: EVE: ...This was a culmination of my failures and weaknesses,
ja: イヴ: ……これは、わたしの失敗と弱さの集大成だった、

key: And the most I can do is arm you with knowledge.
en: And the most I can do is arm you with knowledge.
ja: わたしにできる精一杯のことは、あなたに知識を持たせてあげることだけ。

key: I'm sorry.
en: I'm sorry.
ja: ごめんなさい。

key: Please see it put to rest.
en: Please see it put to rest.
ja: どうか、あれに安らぎを与えてあげて。

key: The console displays a numerical keypad.
en: The console displays a numerical keypad.
ja: コンソールに数字のキーパッドが表示されている。

key: Enter code?
en: Enter code?
ja: コードを入力する?

key: Something clicked open!
en: Something clicked open!
ja: 何かがカチッと開いた!

key: Nothing happened...
en: Nothing happened...
ja: 何も起こらなかった……

key: A PokéBall is inside!
en: A PokéBall is inside!
ja: 中にモンスターボールが入っている!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
